source_boundary: Approved public residence listing and detail pages only; published StarRez URLs are navigation evidence and are never fetched.
missing_value_semantics: Missing source evidence stays unknown; it is not false, unavailable, ineligible, or zero.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Exact source-backed category membership when present.

field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Inferring location from a residence name, contact block, or nearby text.
Synonym expansion or inferring catering from features or room prose.
Personal eligibility or guessed audience equivalence.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display or compare the exact advertised-rate wording with its source context.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Numeric normalization, total-cost calculation, cheapest ranking, or filling a missing advertised rate from a room rate.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Qualify displayed room and advertised rate evidence with the exact published period.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Assuming currentness, equivalence between periods, or an unstated contract interval.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Compare source-backed room objects while preserving name, rate, contract, inclusions, and other-fee pairing.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Flattening fields across rooms, numeric price ranking, or detaching rates from cost period and contract wording.
Synonym expansion or treating an absent feature as false.
Deterministic filtering or extracting unstated attributes.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display exact published accessibility wording when present.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: A universal accessibility boolean or inference from generic features.
Application outcome, eligibility, vacancy, or availability inference.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Navigate to the exact published outbound application URL.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Fetching authenticated StarRez, deriving application status, or treating link presence as vacancy.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display exact published eligibility wording when present.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: A personal eligibility decision or inference from audience labels.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Display published email, phone, location, and hours without filling missing subfields.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Availability, open-now status, or contact-detail synthesis.

field_capabilities.supported_use: Use only an explicit published vacancy statement; null means not established.
field_capabilities.unsupported_use: Inferring available, unavailable, or false from rates, rooms, application links, or missing text.
